scope: Step 4 moves the introduced species' bodies, words and bindings onto their final class files in one commit. Deferred classes (steps 7-10) keep their bodies and words on FElysiumNpc in the listed transitional homes; Troika and base bodies do not move (steps 5-6).

owner_decisions.2026-09-26 preflight commit: Packet 4a (records and checker, no C++) lands as its own prerequisite commit, as 3a did. The atomic step-4 commit holds all C++, generated output, tests and oracle updates.
owner_decisions.2026-09-26 class tables: An introduced species' row in a class-keyed table becomes the body of its own override (the row is the body). A table is deleted once only deferred rows or non-dispatch readers remain; the survivors are listed here.
owner_decisions.2026-09-26 scurrying scope: Step 4 does not port CNPC_VScurrying GatherConditions 0x103ac500 or StartTask 0x103ac740: both are band 19-29 rule rows story 8 pass I lands (Conditions19, StartTask19), onto the tree step 4 builds. Step 4 binds the eight keys and asserts ScurryingShouldDetect 0x103acac0 (incl. 0x103acb1a) and ScurryingFindFleeDestination 0x103acba0 directly on authored values.

rules.move: A member moves to the closest class over its users when every user is a species definition or another moving member (to a fixed point). A ported body retail places on an introduced species stands on that owner when every port user stands on it or beneath it; an unwired body (no port user) stands on its retail owner; an address-less unwired member follows the species state and bodies it names (data access). Users include free functions and header code, which keep a member on FElysiumNpc.
rules.collapse: A moving member whose only user is one override of its own class is inlined into that override (the forwarding override collapses); `collapse:table` removes a class table whose rows become override bodies; `collapse:split` replaces one port field standing for several retail words with one word per declaring class.
rules.stay: A virtual the species override (the surface), a Troika or base body (its address is below the V-species objects), Troika API the moved bodies still call, a helper two sibling lines share (a sibling cannot call a species member), a species word a Troika activity predicate reads (the activity alias tables live to step 11), and a class table a Troika body or free code reads (`stay:data-query table`).
rules.deferred: A member a deferred class's body owns or reads stays on FElysiumNpc until that class folds (`deferred:<step>`).
rules.retail_owner: The kernel ledger's direct-call owner of the member's addresses, proposed from GOverrides' introducing class and direct callers (graph.tsv). Only addresses inside the V-species objects (0x1035c000-0x103e2000, and CPayphone's 0x101aa000-0x101ac000) can be species bodies; an address past them is a cited global, not a body.
rules.bindings: fields-step4.tsv is every record of an introduced species' own datamap in the pinned replay (the empty terminator row of Camera/Human/Vampire/... names nothing and is skipped). The class-qualified species shape map (ElysiumNpcKernelSpeciesShapeMap.cpp) answers every field row by (declaring class, offset): `bind` an existing carrier, `declare` a new one, `shadow` a re-declared Troika word onto the inherited storage, or `absent` with the word's retail accessors. A keyed row registers under its external, a SAVE-only row under its retail member name, an array word once per element (`m_rhProxies[3]`), all on the declaring class's descriptor only; descendants inherit through the descriptor chain. An input binds a ported body or an explicit pending seam; an output is a generated output-name row.
rules.saves: Retail saves a species word only through its datamap SAVE row (or a class's own Save/Restore body). Step 4 adds no blob persistence for species words without one; they take their constructor defaults on restore, as retail.
rules.declare: A new member is declared for every KEY row (authored data must land and be saved) and for each word a split carrier stood for. A SAVE-only word no ported body reads or writes stays `absent`: saving a word nothing writes restores its constructor value either way, and the map row names its retail accessors for the story that ports them.
rules.words_follow_the_datamap: A species word lives on the class whose datamap declares it, whatever its port users: a body of another class that reads it (a head reading its tentacle, a shared pickup helper) reaches it through a typed instance. The binding manifest therefore overrides the move manifest's users-based placement for words (moves-step4.tsv rows corrected in 4b).
rules.base_seams_stay: A seam for a base engine call stays on FElysiumNpc (`stay:troika api`) even when one species is its only caller; a seam for a species' own retail callee moves with that species (SeverTentacle, NearestPointOnEntity, FireWerewolfZoneTrigger).
rules.adapters_stay_helpers: An override that converts its arguments (GetEnemy(), state ids, blocker handles) or runs a gate or prologue before the body keeps the body as an own helper (`move`), not a collapse; only a pure forward with the override's own parameters is inlined.
rules.typed_species_access: A body that reads another class's words reaches them through FElysiumNpc::AsSpecies<T>(), gated on the C++ class's own census row (OwnRetailClassDerivesFrom); where retail tests the class first (RTDynamicCast / IsRetailClass) the typed view follows that test. No unchecked downcast.
rules.protected_troika_state: FElysiumNpc's former private section is protected, so species bodies reach Troika state as retail's derived classes do.
rules.splits_land_with_the_last_reader: A split carrier splits when the last branch reading it moves (4g), each class taking its own word.
rules.record_only_tables: A class table whose every row names a body the class's override already owns is deleted, not collapsed; its test asserts the census body and the override's behaviour (slots 615, 141, 516, 68/69).

findings.finding: The tutorial rats' eight keys become effective in step 4, but nothing in the port reaches ScurryingShouldDetect 0x103acac0 or ScurryingFindFleeDestination 0x103acba0: their retail callers, CNPC_VScurrying GatherConditions 0x103ac500 (slot 433, COND 0x78) and StartTask 0x103ac740 (TASK 0x14a), are unported residue (overrides-step3.tsv). Step 4 moves both bodies onto FElysiumNpcScurrying, binds the keys and asserts the bodies on authored values, including 0x103acb1a. Played detection and fright need the residue ports (story 8) unless the owner widens step 4.

CNPCMaker_Zombie and CNPCMaker_Fleshpile read or write species words (the zombie's m_iZombieAIType +0x6678, the Andrei's m_iActiveRunnerCount +0x66b8 and m_iKillCount +0x66bc). Their storage stays on FElysiumNpc (deferred:8) and the species descriptors bind to it until step 8 folds the makers.

SpeciesShunnedFindCount stands for three retail words on three classes (CNPC_VGargoyle m_iShunnedFindPillar +0x6680, CNPC_VHengeyokai m_iShunnedFindFish +0x6678, CNPC_VTzimisce m_iShunnedFindBody +0x66b8). Step 4 splits it (collapse:split).

Some species datamaps re-declare an inherited Troika word (Hengeyokai and Tzimisce m_flIgnoreCollisionTimer +0x6458; SabbatLeader and VampireBoss m_bJumping +0x6498 and the jump vectors). Each binds explicitly on its class to the inherited storage (shadow) and keeps its own flags.

Families declared their own member for a retail word another family had already declared, so 11 retail words have two or three port carriers that can disagree (Bach +0x6690 has BachNextHolyLightTime, BachFailStamp and BachRepositionTimer; SabbatLeader +0x66c8/+0x66d5, AsianVampire +0x66d4/+0x66e8, MingXiao +0x66c4[4..5]/+0x6710/+0x6718, ManBat +0x6674, Hengeyokai/Tzimisce pickup target). One survivor each binds; the others collapse into it in 4c (moves-step4.tsv `collapse:merge`). Merging makes a write one family made visible to the other family's reader: each merge is a retail correction with a test.

Three port members stand for words of two classes: SpeciesShunnedFindCount (three classes), SpeciesPickupTarget (Hengeyokai +0x6664, Tzimisce +0x6670), PathMode (Tzimisce +0x668c datamap, Hengeyokai +0x6680 walked), and MingXiaoTentacleId (the head's +0x6674 and the tentacle's own +0x6660, now TentacleId). Each splits to one member per declaring class (4c-4g).

CNPC_VZombie's datamap saves m_bShouldGib (+0x66e0), but retail writes the latch one byte past it (+0x66e1, 0x103e0430); the saved word is never written and the latch is not saved. The port's bZombieShouldGib stands for +0x66e1 and stays unsaved; the +0x66e0 row is absent.

The ZombieAIType key is a plain datamap write (no reroll, no order push); only the SetZombieAIType input (0x103e0e30, name parser 0x103e0cd0) and the zombie maker (0x1034cf20) call SetZombieAIType 0x103e0980. The key binds as a field on the deferred storage; the input stays a pending seam.

A species save round trip rewrites five words through retail's own bodies: the Gargoyle, Hengeyokai and Tzimisce slot-435 OnScheduleChange tails (the restore restarts the program, as the Troika round trip already names) decrement the shunned counters and clear m_ePathMode, and CNPC_VPedestrian::OnRestore 0x103a25a0 re-runs NPCInit on a load, clearing m_bFirstThink. The round-trip case names each.
